Test 24-26: ROOT = Path(env); ROOT = ROOT.with_name(ROOT.name + "-qualification"); ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True). For a relative value with a normal final name, the result has the same parent, a different name and the same depth, so it is not equal to, an ancestor of or a descendant of the smoke ROOT; parents=True creates only shared ancestors. An empty or '.' final name makes with_name raise ValueError, a loud failure. Author attempt/IMPORT-ORDER.json (qualification first): smoke ROOT absent after the qualification import, then created by the smoke import. Smoke-first order was not run; by construction the unchanged smoke module (158c4e32) sets up its ROOT before any qualification code runs, and the later sibling mkdir cannot equal or contain that ROOT.

A residue above 1e-9 with zero counters would still fail closed at the original deadline, as intended for a leaked ledger.
